tools.label: Context handoff
tools.description: Write a concise structured handoff, then END THIS TURN without more tools. Recovery continues automatically; an idle request resets the context at the end of this turn. Separate facts from hypotheses and preserve user constraints verbatim.

goal.description: What the session is trying to achieve.

next_step.description: The single next action to take on resume.

facts.description: Verified facts only; verify before relying on them.

hypotheses.description: Unverified theories, kept separate from facts.

items.description: ABSOLUTE path (relative paths are resolved against the cwd).

files_to_read.description: Existing files to read first on resume; relative paths resolve against cwd. Keep state files current.

watch_actions.description: Required for each running watch/job/subagent. Use its exact id (or a unique prefix of at least 8 characters), target and completion follow-up.

launch_prompt.description: Optional. The prompt to start the relaunched session with: either the prompt text (saved to a file for you) or an ABSOLUTE path to an existing file containing it.
